verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs mention SCA/dependency scanning surfacing findings in merge requests (gitlab-docs-2, gitlab-docs-3) and AI agents that can 'remediate vulnerabilities' and turn issues into merge requests (gitlab-docs-1), which implies some automated remediation MR capability similar to dependency-bump PRs. However, there is no explicit documentation of an automated 'dependency update bot' feature (like Dependabot/Renovate) that proactively opens PRs solely for outdated/vulnerable dependency version bumps. Missing for 10: explicit description of automatic dependency-update MR generation, examples/screenshots of such MRs, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this works as claimed.
